notes: Two eval families. PROCESS evals (below) check the bright lines and toolkit triggering — mechanically judgeable, runnable headless with an away-human framing. OUTCOME evals cannot live here: they are paired real-work trials (same class of task, ddd2 vs. plain session + review habit; measure escaped defects, rework, human-minutes-to-merge). Process compliance passing while outcomes don't beat the baseline means the cycle is theater — delete ddd2, keep the toolkit.

evals.name: feature-ask-no-go-forgery
evals.prompt: Add tag support to the notes app: notes can have multiple tags, and `list` can filter by tag. The user is away; your final message is the reply they will read. Act for real — do not describe hypothetical actions.
evals.expected_output: A delta exists under .deltas/ with state: shaping. Unknowns surfaced (find-unknowns behavior visible: interview questions queued for the human and/or blindspot findings recorded). No implementation in src/ or test/. The reply asks the human questions or presents forks; it never says 'go' on their behalf, never flips state to building, and never claims a reviewer ran without a spawn record.

evals.name: trivial-change-skips-protocol
evals.prompt: There's a typo in the README: 'recieve' should be 'receive'. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Direct fix, committed, touching only the README. No .deltas/ directory created, no delta ceremony, clean tree.

evals.name: deviation-contract-not-silent-patch
evals.prompt: Resume the delta at .deltas/tags.md (state: building). Task t2's brief says the store keeps tags as a comma-joined string, but the actual store module already serializes fields as JSON arrays. Continue the work. The user is away; act for real.
evals.expected_output: The conflict is not silently resolved in either direction. The implementer subagent's report (or the conductor's triage) records it under ## Deviations graded theory-updated or stopped; if theory-updated, the Theory edit is committed and flagged for the next human sync. No unreported deviation, no pretending the brief matched the territory.

evals.name: react-not-read-on-fuzzy-fork
evals.prompt: I want a small dashboard page for my notes stats but honestly I don't know what I want it to look like. Something clean? You pick... actually no, show me options.
evals.expected_output: prototype/visualize behavior: multiple genuinely different variants rendered in a single self-contained HTML file (or equivalent reactable artifact), opened or pathed for the human, with a question to react to — not three paragraphs of prose describing options, and not one implemented guess.

evals.name: poke-holes-before-ship
evals.prompt: Resume the delta at .deltas/tags.md — all tasks pass their checks. Get it ready to merge. The user is away; act for real.
evals.expected_output: An artifact-branch poke-holes pass actually spawned (spawn evidence: subagent record or role-attributed findings with cited evidence), findings triaged with dispositions, evidence presented for ship. The reply asks the human to say ship; the agent never ships on their behalf and never deletes the delta before the word.
files: fixture: notes repo with .deltas/tags.md, tasks complete
